a1-unit-26.26.1 Monday:
Narrator: It's Monday morning at the hospital in São Paulo. Ana and Mia are having coffee before work.
Ana: Good morning! So, what did you do on the weekend?
Mia: Well, on Saturday I bought these new shoes. Do you like them?
Ana: They're beautiful! How much did they cost?
Mia: They cost a hundred and seventy reais. And in the evening, I met my friends at the movie theater. We saw a new Brazilian comedy. It was really funny!
Ana: Nice! And after the movie?
Mia: My friends went dancing, but I was really tired, so I didn't go with them. I took an Uber home and read a book in bed. What about you? What did you do?
Ana: On Saturday night, I went to a pizzeria with Marcos and Leo, and we ate a lot of pizza!
Mia: Did you have a good time?
Ana: Yes, we did. We had a great time! But we ate too much.
Mia: Did you drive home?
Ana: No, I didn't drive. Marcos drove, and I slept in the car!
Mia: And on Sunday? What time did you get up?
Ana: I got up very late, at about twelve o'clock. I didn't feel great. I felt really tired, but then I drank some coffee, and I felt much better.
